chemistry.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists NMC cathode, 77.4 kWh, 697 V for the IONIQ 6 Long Range (MY23-25, European), same model and generation and pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: navigation trigger (DC charger as destination/waypoint) stated for the 2023 IONIQ 6 (no manual control then); manual start via Bluelink app or in-car button stated on Hyundai Ireland's IONIQ 6 page (src-hyundai-ie-ioniq6-features). Combined across years/markets.

charge_port.notes: Hyundai Canada FAQ: Hyundai EVs of model year 2025 and earlier use CCS and need a NACS adapter; IONIQ 6 not named.
US page: 2025 IONIQ 6 kept CCS1 (model ended with MY2025).

supercharger_access.notes: Hyundai Canada FAQ: owners of CCS-port 2025-and-earlier Hyundai EVs reach Tesla Superchargers (146 Canadian stations) with a separately available NACS adapter. IONIQ 6 not named. A forum post claims a free Canadian adapter programme from 2026-06-01; not confirmed on a Hyundai page.
